title: Mixed Event — The Sounds of a Summer Festival! — Episode6 I'm Not Giving Up

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!
meta.Event Outline: Akito and Toya are invited to perform at the Summer Festival's live concert as a substitute act. Back when Akito had lost sight of his goals after facing setbacks in soccer, he and Ena witnessed that very same event...

rows.Line: Summer Festival Fairgrounds

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The gang's all here!
Glad you made it out early too, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They apparently scheduled the studying room to be cleaned today, so we ended up having to leave.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nice, today's your lucky day♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, we still have time until the concert starts, so wanna take a look at some of those stalls?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The stalls...? I hardly ever come to festivals like this, so I have no idea what's here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then we should check some out!
Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, Mizuki...!
We'll get separated if you run off like that!
Shooting Gallery

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
How's this...?!
No, I missed...! I can't hit anything...!!
se_event_natsumatsuri_2021_008

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You're an awful shot, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't blame me! This isn't exactly a regular thing for me!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There...?
se_event_natsumatsuri_2021_009

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hold on, did you shoot down all of those prizes, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, she even got the toughest one! Why didn't you tell us you were so good at this, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm not. This is my first time.
It's easy. Just point and shoot.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, that wasn't directed at me, was it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Not really. I'm just saying what I felt.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? You...
se_event_natsumatsuri_2021_008

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? You have to pull this trigger pretty hard, huh...? I can't hit anything, and this thing's heavier than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you okay, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
My arm's starting to get sore, so I think I'll take a break.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, there's no need to push yourself like that. Ena can't hit anything either, so don't worry!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Says you...!
You hardly hit anything either, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, I got one.
Check out my keychain!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What's this character...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's Shibunyago, a local character that represents Shibuya. It's been getting some press lately♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is it supposed to be a cat? It doesn't look very cute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, that's the best part!
Its eyes are sort of meant to made fun of, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm gonna put it on my bag right now♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, right now?
It totally clashes with how your bag looks too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Who cares?
It'll be something to remember this festival by♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Remember this festival...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki actually wants to commemorate this occasion...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
There we go...
Look, isn't it cute?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it doesn't match your bag at all. But I guess it doesn't matter if it's something special...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, are we all done with the shooting gallery?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I've had zero luck so far, so I'm done.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Copy that!
Alright, what's next? Anyone hungry?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, not quite yet...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then how about we try balloon fishing next?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, won't those get in the way during the concert?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's not like we're gonna get that many, right? Don't worry!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: C'mon, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, wait! What did I tell you about running off like that?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, how about we buy some of these penguin masks for Haruka and Minori?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good idea! It's pretty cute too, so I'm sure Haruka will like it. We might even be able to use them in one of our videos.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, there's something on the ground...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
A keychain?
Oh, it's so cute♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You think it's cute...?
Its eyes look kinda weird...
Did someone drop it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That was so much fun!
I wish we could do stuff like this with Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But even if we tried to do that in SEKAI, there's nothing there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: True... But we could try doing some of these things in SEKAI, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Such as?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Like balloon fishing and the shooting gallery? We could use rubber band guns instead and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Miku might like that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I do sort of want to get another crack at the shooting gallery. I really don't like going home empty-handed like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Especially considering how awful you were...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! Anyway, just food for thought if we ever get that chance...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh, no... It's nothing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Isn't the show about to start? I know the amateur division's first, but we should probably still check it out, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki was trying to say something just now, but stopped partway through...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I thought we were all having fun, but I'm still sensing some hesitation there...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Ena, is everything okay?
We don't want you to get separated.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
Be right there!
Summer Festival Stage

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's more people than I expected here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah. Kanade, how do you feel?
Is this too big a crowd for you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: N-No, I'm still okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We should be fine as long as we don't go too far forward, right? That tree over there might be a good spot. I don't see many people around it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think so too. It looks like a good viewing spot.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then let's head over that way!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot about the frozen drink I brought. It's probably just right now, so you can have some too, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My keychain's gone...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You mean the one you just won at the shooting gallery?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was still on your bag a minute ago.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
Did I drop it somewhere...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You did?
We should go find it right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Uh... No, it's fine.
Everything's about to start, and I doubt we'll have any luck finding it in this crowd.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I thought you really like it, Mizuki. You wanted to keep it to remember this day by, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, but...
It's okay, just forget about it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I'm not going to.
You're really just gonna give up before you even try to look for it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But the show's about to start...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Shut up and listen to me!
We're gonna go find it right now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: E-Ena?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade, Mafuyu, can you wait for us here? We'll try to be back before the pros take the stage.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: B-Be careful...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Summer Festival Fairgrounds

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Find it, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, it's not here.
Let's just go back. There's just no way we're gonna find it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm gonna put it on my bag right now♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, right now?
It totally clashes with how your bag looks too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Who cares?
It'll be something to remember this festival by♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, let's keep looking.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But it's just a stupid keychain.
Do we really have to keep looking...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's gonna really bother me if we don't!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know! It might be at the lost and found! Let's try there, Mizuki...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Ena, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Seriously? It's here...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: See? Like I said...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way, do you remember who delivered this to you?

rows.Speaker: Female Staff
rows.Line:
Two girls.
They said that they found it by the outdoor stage.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really...?
Thanks, Ena. I owe you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't mention it. I was the one that made you look for it in the first place. Let's just get back to Kanade and Mafuyu now, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line:
Huh?
Someone's stuff is in this box. This is supposed to be for extension cords.

rows.Speaker: Committee Member B
rows.Line: Look at that. It's someone's bag and... Their shoes?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wait, those are...)
